svg.title: Filename identity and temporary provider overrides
svg.desc: Relative-input coverage already exists in the parent; its provider is wired through a module. The provider-swap regression is new. Lookup uses the requested document identity even when the frontend input name differs. The new swap test disables checks, restores the provider, and checks the original diagnostic.
svg.text: Filename identity and temporary provider overrides
Relative-input coverage already exists in the parent; its provider is wired through a module. The provider-swap regression is new.
// Configuration lookup must use the requested file, not the frontend input.
// Configuration lookup must use the requested file, not the frontend input.
// Check-mode timing temporarily overrides tidy's configuration, then
// restores the original provider for subsequent builds.
Lookup uses the requested document identity even when the frontend input name differs.
The new swap test disables checks, restores the provider, and checks the original diagnostic.
Source: 101584320859 → c64f1fca38c6 • Exact snapshots; arrows map responsibilities, not every line
